type: industrial-AI SaaS — HIGHLY TRANSFERABLE motion + type system (3D renders optional)
moves: hero: full-bleed pastel 3D render card with inset radius; wordmark in custom stencil face top (mobile); label row 'N°001 | The Digital Twin of Everything'; statement in lime 64px over the image
HIGHLIGHTER SWIPE: a lime (or lilac) block grows left→right behind the key phrase of each headline on reveal
TEXT SCRUB: paragraph words fill from grey → ink/lime as you scroll (colour follows scroll position)
headline bounded by hairline rules above and below each line (3 rules per 2-line headline)
numbered chapters 01/02 with per-chapter accent colour (lime, lilac)
2-col: tall rounded render card left, number+headline+paragraph right; alternates sides per chapter
bottom pill nav: How · Menu · Login (black pill) · Contact (lime pill) — floating, centred
tiny lime dot as custom cursor/marker
mobile: card first, then number/headline/text stack; pill nav stays bottom
rules_derived: highlight-swipe + text-scrub are the two cheapest 'premium' motion moves — do them in GSAP once
big body text (24px+) with scroll colouring makes reading feel like an event
rules above/below headlines = editorial structure without boxes
per-chapter accent colour from a 2-3 colour pastel set
bottom floating pill nav is mobile-first and reads modern on desktop
